title: A workflow rule can change Status on a ticket the blueprint controls; the ticket closes and leaves the blueprint

panels.caption: TAVI API: rule saved; direct Status change refused (422); after a transition the rule closes the ticket and it leaves the blueprint
Zoho: Status shows a lock while the blueprint controls it; the blueprint strip shows the current state
TAVI ticket #1067 after the transition: Status Closed, no Steps card, "Reopen ticket"

rows: Status is locked while a blueprint controls the ticket; only its transitions change it.
A rule (On Edit, Field Update Status = Closed) is saved with no warning that Status is controlled by a blueprint.
Refused: PATCH status → 422 "Governed picklist field can only change via blueprint transition execution."
The ticket stays in the blueprint at the new state.

Transition Open → Escalated runs, then the rule sets Status to Closed: ticket #1067 is Closed and has left the blueprint (no Steps card, "Reopen ticket"). The blueprint lock is bypassed through normal admin setup.
